title: Slugs
hints: Read the rules as a list of separate promises. For each promise, write one input that breaks if *only* that promise is broken.
You need cases for: uppercase letters, digits, a run of several separators, a separator at the start, and one at the end. `"Hello World"` alone checks almost nothing.

```go
tests := []struct{ in, want string }{
	{"Hello World", "hello-world"},
	{"Go 1.27", "go-1-27"},
	{"a  --  b", "a-b"},
	{"  Leading", "leading"},
	{"Trailing!!", "trailing"},
}
```
